name: GitHub
summary: Code hosting with pull requests, issues, Actions and the Copilot agents: Copilot code review, which reviews a pull request's full changeset and comments on the lines that need attention, and Copilot coding agent, which takes a task from an issue or a prompt, makes the changes in its own GitHub Actions environment and opens a pull request. For agents, the vendor publishes a remote GitHub MCP server over repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and code security, and the Copilot tools; it authenticates by OAuth or a personal access token, measured 401 without one.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-11 23:37Z, no credentials: MCP initialize at api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ answers 401 with a Bearer challenge naming its protected-resource metadata. Vendor: OAuth on first use, or a personal access token; a GitHub App for non-interactive use. Copilot tools need a Copilot license.

jobs.summary: Copilot code review, the vendor's words: "Reviews the full changeset across files to flag bugs, security risks, and style issues" and "comments directly on the lines that need attention"; a "first-pass" review. In the product, on request or on every pull request; needs a Copilot plan. Not measured.

Copilot coding agent, the vendor's words: it "will make the required changes and open a pull request" for a task from an issue or a prompt, in an environment where it can "execute automated tests and linters"; can "Fix bugs", "Implement incremental new features". Copilot Pro and up. Not measured.
